# Revstage

> Revstage is a local-first BOM (bill of materials) control workspace in development for small hardware teams. This is a pre-launch product overview, not a download or release notice.

## Positioning

Revstage is being built for small hardware teams that have outgrown spreadsheet BOMs. Its product direction focuses on released revisions, reference designators, approved manufacturer-part alternates, where-used context, and inventory locations in a workspace managed by the customer.

Revstage is not an ERP, MRP, purchasing system, supplier quote service, hosted BOM cloud, or compliance product. Core BOM work is designed not to depend on a hosted cloud service or a server to run.

## Product direction

The product is being developed to support:
- BOM revision review and change context
- Reference-designator and quantity checks
- Approved, conditional, and blocked alternate status
- Where-used analysis across products and revisions
- Inventory quantities and bin locations
- Local-first workspace ownership

These are planned product capabilities and should not be described as a currently released build.

## Availability

- Mac and iPad App Store availability is in preparation.
- Revstage is not yet listed or available to download.
- Pricing and release timing have not been announced.
- The site remains at https://partspan.evelyn-ai.com/ while domain decisions are pending.
- The earlier public PartSpan v0.1.1 release is a legacy build, not the current Revstage release.

## Privacy and support

The product direction avoids requiring hosted BOM storage. Full privacy and support information will be published before downloads or subscriptions become available.

This public site does not contain or link to the private product source code.
